fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Decoding the Twelve Days of Christmas", "body": "Beth Martens recounted a card from her friend that tied each gift in the carol to a Christian teaching, and she argued the song was written to hide teachings that could not be preached openly. She went day by day while Chance guessed along, from the partridge in a pear tree as Jesus who died on a tree, to the three French hens as hope, faith and love, to the twelve drummers as the points of the Apostles' Creed. Chance looked up the Beatitudes and Galatians on screen, and a viewer's artwork of the twelve days was shared from the call-in line."}, {"title": "Phrygian Caps, Papa Smurf, and Liberty", "body": "Chance opened by screen sharing the seal of the United States Senate and joking that the cap above it was Papa Smurf, then played a voice message from Allen Marcus claiming to have found a hidden smurf in the seal art. Later Chance claimed the Phrygian cap was a Liberty cap and a mark of freed slaves and Freemason initiation, and he linked the Liberty cap mushroom to the Eleusinian mysteries. Gabe's voicemail then claimed that Templar communion rituals used mushrooms to convince initiates they were chosen."}, {"title": "Law, Scripture, and Disputed History", "body": "Beth said her study of law led her to the Bible, which some people treat as a secular contract, and she relayed a friend's view that scripture works like a potluck where each person takes what nourishes them. Chance read that the Apostles' Creed is not in the Bible and likely dates to fifth century Gaul, then said he distrusted Rome's version of history. He described a lawyer's YouTube series proposing that the Old Testament belongs to a different timeline, citing flipped old maps and a theory placing Jerusalem in Barcelona, and he asked listeners to test it."}, {"title": "Divination, Coaching, and the Hero's Journey", "body": "Chance said he preferred divination style coaching because the universe gave him the answers, and he separated it from fortune telling by saying he offered possibilities, not predictions of the future. He pointed to drawing the death card just after saying the word as a wink from source. A guest who joined by video credited Beth's hero's journey teaching with changing his life, Sean called Beth his teacher and recommended her coaching, and Beth described building a community on her own land in Manitoba."}, {"title": "Orgone, Holistic Health, and Desert Rebirth", "body": "Chance said he believed the orgone devices he gifted around his home had cleared the chemtrail haze from his sky, describing a grid of frequency that holds sprayed material in place, and he urged listeners to try it themselves. He said Gordy, calling in from Arizona, could back up the story because he was watching the desert transform, and Gordy agreed it was happening all over the place. Participants also traded views on moving away from conventional medicine toward small farms, herbs, and direct relationships with physicians instead of corporate middlemen."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Beth Martens joins Vibe Rant for a slice of post-solstice pi! Let's unwind and prepare for the next turn of the yearly wheel, and reflect on all we've seen since we last passed the gates of Janus. Now's the time when the Christos prepares to rise, so let's talk about Jesus too.
